review_kind: AI-reviewed translation (Claude, direct exact-source translation and technical self-review); no native-speaker signoff
review_method: Direct translation of the two Timepose v1 (alpha) Timelapse settings and the preview note added for item 711. Preserve timelapse_mode, timepose_v1, spaCR, Timepose, Hugging Face, DIC and False.

records.source: With timelapse_mode='timepose_v1', invert the image intensities before Timepose reads them. Turn on for brightfield, phase-contrast and DIC movies; leave off for fluorescence. Default False.
records.translation: Avec timelapse_mode='timepose_v1', inverse les intensités de l'image avant que Timepose ne les lise. À activer pour les films en fond clair, en contraste de phase et en DIC ; à laisser désactivé pour la fluorescence. Par défaut False.

records.source: With timelapse_mode='timepose_v1', replace the masks spaCR segmented with Timepose's own segmentation before linking. Off links spaCR's masks. Default False.
records.translation: Avec timelapse_mode='timepose_v1', remplace les masques segmentés par spaCR par la segmentation propre de Timepose avant la liaison. Désactivé, les masques de spaCR sont liés. Par défaut False.

records.key: Timepose v1 (alpha) tracks in the full Timelapse run. Set timelapse_mode to timepose_v1 in the settings. It needs a Hugging Face account with access to its private model, so this preview does not offer it.
records.source: Timepose v1 (alpha) tracks in the full Timelapse run. Set timelapse_mode to timepose_v1 in the settings. It needs a Hugging Face account with access to its private model, so this preview does not offer it.
records.translation: Timepose v1 (alpha) effectue le suivi dans l'exécution Timelapse complète. Réglez timelapse_mode sur timepose_v1 dans les paramètres. Il nécessite un compte Hugging Face ayant accès à son modèle privé ; cet aperçu ne le propose donc pas.
